import Lake
open Lake DSL

package mveiReconstruido

require mathlib from git
  "https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4" @ "v4.19.0"

@[default_target] lean_lib MveiReconstruido where
  srcDir := "."
  globs := #[.one `Main, .one `MillenniumRiemann, .submodules `MillenniumRiemann, .submodules `cross, .submodules `formal, .submodules `lean, .submodules `src]
